meta.script: hebb/sweeps/s8_private_noise.py (parts A R M P X DT L N; Modal helper s8_modal.py)
meta.description: Allocation of neurons to parts under PRIVATE (independent per-synapse) noise. Does the allocation equilibrate (forget the init) and, if so, what law n_k(lambda_k; theta, sigma) does the stationary state obey? gamma=0 lone-neuron limit (thousands of independent neurons; no lateral synapses) and N=120 networks with gamma in {0,1}.
meta.units: lam = eta = 1: weights and theta in covariance units, time in units of 1/lam; Euler dt = 0.05; wmin = 1e-4 unless stated. sigma is per sqrt(time unit).

noise_models.add: dw = drift dt + sigma sqrt(dt) xi, then clip at wmin
noise_models.mul: w <- w exp(sigma sqrt(dt) xi) after the drift step, then clip at wmin (median-neutral)
noise_models.inp: private covariance-estimation noise: each synapse estimates Cov from its own samples, n = 1/sigma^2 samples per unit time; Gaussian approx, Var per step = sigma^2 dt (C_xx C_yy + C_xy^2), independent across synapses (I-B: q_i Sigma_bb + (Sigma h_i)_b^2; I-I: gamma^2 (q_i q_j + C_ij^2))
noise_models.inpn: as inp but one private sample stream per neuron (correlated across its synapses)

diag_sigma.note: Sigma = diag(v); parts = vertices e_b with c_b = v_b - theta; lambda_b = v_b

measures.alloc: fraction of neurons whose nearest part (max cosine) is k, time-averaged over the second half
measures.core: fraction with cos(h, part k) >= 0.9 (in the part); transit = 1 - sum(core)
measures.off_mass: mean mass of h outside the support of the nearest part
measures.cos_inst: mean over neurons of cos(h_i, nearest part)
measures.cos_mean: cos(time- and member-averaged h of core-k neurons, part k)
measures.hop_rate: milestoning transitions between part cores per neuron per unit time (second half)
measures.relax: slowest relaxation time 1/|eig_2| of the measured milestoning rate matrix (inf if not irreducible)
measures.pi_rates: stationary distribution of the measured rate matrix
measures.beta: slope of log alloc vs log v over parts with alloc > 1e-3 (rms = residual in log units)
measures.tv_weak_strong: total variation between the stationary allocations started from 'weak' and 'strong' inits
measures.arrhenius: ln(out-rate of vertex) = a - 2*barrier/sigma^2 (barrier in units of D = sigma^2/2), fitted over sigma
measures.network: per condition: alloc_by_init = core fractions per block (last entry of alloc_t = transit), mean over seeds 0,1 and the second half of the run; metrics are means over seeds and inits; spread_inst = mean L1 of members' h to their part-cluster mean (core members); vcorr_inst = mean pairwise voltage correlation within a part-cluster; pr_inst = participation ratio of within-cluster voltage covariance; lat_sum_per_neuron = summed lateral conductance per neuron at the end
measures.persistence: network: correlation between the deviations of a neuron's time-averaged embedding from its cluster mean in the 3rd vs 4th quarter of the run (1 = frozen individual differences, 0 = jitter)

inits.weak: all neurons at the weakest vertex fixed point

seeds.A: noise seed 7, init seed 123, M=1000 per init

P.family: 4 blocks of 3, within 0.6, across 0; var: block-0 variance x; size: block-0 size x at unit variance; ratio = frac0 / mean frac of the other blocks; beta = slope of log ratio vs log(lambda0/lambda_ref)

N.init: W_IB ~ Exp(0.2), W_II ~ U(0,0.03) for rand; block inits put all neurons on one block with W_II at the floor
N.lateral: noise on lateral synapses too (True) or only on I-B synapses (False)
